spans.s:
f. (-धुः)
1 A son's wife.
2 A wife in general.
E.
वह to bear, उ aff., more commonly वधू.

f. (-धूः)
1 Woman in general, a female.
2 A wife.
3 A young wife, one recently married, a bride.
4 A son's wife.
5 A sort of bulbous root, (Curcuma reclinata.)
6 A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata): see पृक्का.
7 A plant, (Echites frutescens.)
E.
वह to bear, उ aff., and ह changed to ध; also derived from षध to bind, in which case it is written वधू.

f. (-धूः)
A vessel, a boat, a raft.
E.
वह to bear, aff. ऊण्; form irr.

f. (-का)
A wife.
E.
वधु for वधू, and कन् added.

f. (-टी)
1 A son's wife.
2 A young woman living in her father's house, whether married or unmarried.
E.
वह to bear, कूटट् aff., and ह changed to घ.

m. (-नः)
A woman.
E.
वधू a female, and जन person.

(ऋ) ऐवाधृ r. 1st cl. (वाधते)
To distress, to give pain: more correctly बाध.

n. (-क्यं)
Marriage.
E.
वधुका a wife, ष्यञ् aff.
